name: stripe-bg-guides

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the grid plus a visible light pulse on the second column; all frames are near identical.

tagline: Faint light pulses crawl down a field of dashed vertical guides.
summary: A dark page backdrop of six evenly spaced vertical guide lines, drawn as fine white dashes, with pale glowing streaks sliding down some of them. Intended to sit behind marketing copy.
appearance: On black, six evenly spaced vertical lines run the full height, each made of short white dashes, with the outer two solid. A faint pale-blue glow slides along a line here and there. The demo layers a small outlined pill, a large white headline and a grey paragraph in the centre.
behaviour: Glow strips travel down the columns at staggered times and loop forever, while every few seconds a random set of columns switches on or off. The guide lines themselves never move.
demo_content: Badge "Payments infrastructure for the internet", headline "Accept payments and scale faster" and a short paragraph.
search_phrases: vertical grid lines with moving light
thin dashed lines on a dark page
glowing lines travelling down the screen
animated vertical guides behind a hero
use_when: A dark marketing or product page needs a quiet, structured backdrop that moves without drawing attention.
avoid_when: The page needs a bright theme or strong contrast: pale guide lines nearly vanish on light surfaces.
customise: columnCount, direction, easing, glow colour, size and opacity, the randomize interval, maxActiveColumns, darkMode and contained are all props; no source edit needed.
weight_why: Six columns of thin divs with animated gradient strips; no canvas or per-frame script.

a11y.note: Marked aria-hidden, which suits decoration, but the endless glow loop ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The travelling glows are so faint that the frames look almost static.
There is no reduced-motion check, so the pulses keep running for every visitor.
polish_why: Disciplined grid and motion, but the glow is so faint it barely reads in stills.
